features.description: Project skeleton: package.json (exactly the 5 allowed runtime deps + dev deps for TS and a test runner), tsconfig.json (strict), bin/pr-backtest shebang wrapper -> dist/cli.js, MIT LICENSE, src/log.ts (stderr logger), and empty/stub module files so the tree matches SPEC §6. Establish npm scripts: build (tsc), test.
preconditions: Empty repo (no package.json, no src/) on a fresh mission branch off main
expectedBehavior: package.json dependencies are exactly: commander, @octokit/rest, simple-git, prompts, chalk
tsconfig.json has "strict": true and emits to dist/
bin/pr-backtest is a node shebang wrapper that requires ../dist/cli.js; package.json bin maps pr-backtest to it
LICENSE contains the MIT body
src/log.ts writes progress to stderr
npm install succeeds; npm run build runs tsc (may have nothing to compile yet but must not error on config)
verificationSteps: node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(Object.keys(p.dependencies))" shows the five deps

features.description: Implement src/parseUrl.ts: GitHub PR URL -> {owner, repo, number:int}; tolerate trailing slash/segment/query; throw a clear Error on invalid/non-PR URLs. Write test/parseUrl.test.ts.
expectedBehavior: Valid URL -> {owner, repo, number} with number an integer
Trailing slash, /files segment, and ?query suffix all parse identically
Invalid/non-PR URLs throw an Error with a readable message
verificationSteps: npm test -- parseUrl (or run the test runner on test/parseUrl.test.ts)

features.description: Implement src/resolveCommit.ts: resolve --commit (initial | full/abbrev SHA) to a target SHA against the PR commit list, compute base = target.parents[0], reject invalid input. getCommit lookup is injectable for testing. Write test/resolveCommit.test.ts.
expectedBehavior: initial -> earliest-listed single-parent (non-merge) commit
explicit full or >=7-char SHA matched against PR commits and used; non-member SHA rejected
base SHA = target's parents[0]
input that is neither initial nor a valid hex SHA throws a clear error before any I/O

features.description: Implement src/config.ts (XDG/%APPDATA% path, read/write JSON {token,username,source}, mode 0600 on write, 0o077 loosened-perms warning on read, logout via unlink tolerating absence) and src/auth.ts (token resolution order env->config->gh->interactive, gh reuse prompt, fine-grained PAT guidance, masked paste prompt, validate via users.getAuthenticated printing the username, non-TTY+no-token -> exit-1 guidance). Write test/auth.test.ts asserting resolution precedence.
expectedBehavior: Resolution order env -> config -> gh auth token (after prompt) -> interactive paste, first match wins
users.getAuthenticated validates token and the username is surfaced
config written mode 0600; loosened perms (0o077 bits) warn on read
logout removes the config file, tolerating already-absent
interactive prompt is masked (password/invisible)
config schema is {token, username, source in {fine-grained,classic,gh-cli}}
config path honors XDG_CONFIG_HOME / %APPDATA%
gh path runs `gh auth token` only after a reuse prompt; declining falls through
when gh absent, prints fine-grained PAT permissions + personal-access-tokens URL
no token + non-TTY stdin -> exit 1 with setup guidance
verificationSteps: grep checks per the contract AUTH evidence lines

features.description: Implement src/github.ts: Octokit wrappers to fetch the PR (pulls.get) and commits (pulls.listCommits), getCommit for parent resolution, an existing-PR pre-flight check (pulls.list for the head/base pair) returning html_url, and pulls.create (head->base). Post NO comment back to the original PR.
expectedBehavior: Fetches PR + commit list via Octokit
Existing-PR check lists PRs for the planned head/base and returns the existing html_url
Creates the simulated PR head->base via pulls.create
Never calls createComment/issues.create
verificationSteps: grep checks per contract GH evidence

features.description: Implement src/git.ts with simple-git: clone repo (HTTPS, token auth) into a /tmp/pr-backtest-* dir, fetch the target and base SHAs from origin, push both as <sha>:refs/heads/backtest-pr<N>-base|head (no checkout), surface the SPEC §6.5 actionable error (both fallback lines) on fetch failure, and always clean up the temp dir via finally + process.on('exit'). No commit --amend / rebase. main never checked out.
expectedBehavior: Clones into a pr-backtest- temp directory over HTTPS
Fetches specific target+base SHAs from origin
Pushes SHAs to backtest-pr<N>-base/-head via refspec, no local checkout
No simple-git checkout call; main is never a push target
Unfetchable commit -> the §6.5 error with both manual git push fallback lines
Temp dir removed on success and failure (finally + process.on('exit'))
No amend/rebase commit rewriting
verificationSteps: grep checks per contract GIT evidence

features.description: Implement src/plan.ts: build + render the plan (PR identity, target short SHA + label, base, numbered clone/fetch/push/open steps) to stderr, and a [y/N] Continue prompt that returns a declined outcome on no/empty; a yes/skip flag bypasses the prompt while still printing the plan.
expectedBehavior: Plan shows PR, target (short SHA+label), base, numbered steps
[y/N] Continue prompt; decline returns a 'declined' result (no side effects)
yes/skip flag prints plan but skips the prompt
verificationSteps: grep checks per contract PLAN evidence

features.description: Implement src/cli.ts (commander entrypoint: <pr-url> command with --commit <ref> default 'initial' and -y/--yes; logout subcommand) and src/index.ts (runBacktest wiring parseUrl->auth->github->resolveCommit->plan->git->create, exit-code mapping 0/1/2/3/4, PR URL to stdout as final line, token never logged). Whole project typechecks; no any / bare @ts-ignore; no direct network outside Octokit/simple-git.
preconditions: parse-url, resolve-commit, config-and-auth, github-api, git-ops, plan-confirm all complete
expectedBehavior: commander exposes the command, --commit (default initial), -y/--yes, and logout
unparseable URL -> exit 1
exit codes 0/1/2/3/4 mapped per SPEC §3 (sole owner of the numeric mapping)
created PR URL written to stdout as final line; progress to stderr
npm run build is clean; no : any / bare @ts-ignore in src/
no node-fetch/axios/https.request/fetch( in src/
token never passed to a log/console call or written to temp dir
verificationSteps: grep checks per contract CLI/PKG evidence

features.description: Write README.md covering all SPEC §9 sections (What this does, Problem, Install, Setup, Usage, How it works, Safety, Privacy & security, Limitations, Contributing, License) mirroring §5.5 privacy claims; and test/integration.test.ts gated on GITHUB_TOKEN with a TEST_FIXTURE_REPO override, skipped when no token.
expectedBehavior: README has all §9 sections; Privacy section states no telemetry + only api.github.com/github.com egress
integration test exists, skips without GITHUB_TOKEN, honors TEST_FIXTURE_REPO
npm install -g . yields a working pr-backtest --help (verified manually)
